title: Union Minister Smt. Annpurna Devi extends greetings to all Teachers on Teachers' Day
body_text:
Union Minister of Women and Child Development, Smt. Annpurna Devi has extended her heartiest greetings to all teachers on the occasion of Teachers' Day.
In a post on 'X' the Union Minister said that children are the future and the strong foundation of a Viksit Bharat , and our teachers play the most important role in shaping this future.
She called upon everyone to come together to take care of the education, safety and all-round development of children, and to extend full support to teachers in this important responsibility.
सभी गुरुजनों को शिक्षक दिवस की हार्दिक शुभकामनाएं। बच्चे विकसित भारत के भविष्य और मजबूत आधार हैं, और इस भविष्य को गढ़ने में हमारे शिक्षकों की सबसे महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका है। आइए, हम सभी मिलकर बच्चों की शिक्षा, सुरक्षा और सर्वांगीण विकास का ध्यान रखें तथा शिक्षकों को इस महत्वपूर्ण… pic.twitter.com/tpKnEB3fWi — Annpurna Devi (@Annapurna4BJP) September 5, 2026
